Keeps IREE's chosen pipeline (CPUDoubleTilingExpert / CPUConvTileAndDecomposeExpert / CPUBufferOpsTileAndVectorize) and only overrides the root linalg op's lowering_config<tile_sizes = [...]>. Each round reads the best-so-far RISC-V assembly (LMUL, VLmax, register spills) to ground the next tile-size proposal; pre-compile divisibility gate ensures tiles divide their parent extents (no tail loop); a post-compile check of the IR after iree-codegen-generic-vectorization confirms no tail/masked main path. LD        = $(rv64_tc)/bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-ld
OBJDUMP   = $(rv64_tc)/bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-objdump

# Runtime sources live at the repo root (runtime/) -- they are the
# user-facing andesim runtime; fixtures are just one consumer. The linker
# script moved with them (test.ld -> runtime/andesim.ld, same content).
RUNTIME_DIR := ../../runtime
LDSCRIPT    := $(RUNTIME_DIR)/andesim.ld
# Fixture-only helpers (csr ROI markers; NOT part of the portable runtime).
HELPERS_DIR := runtime

CFLAGS  := -march=rv64gc -mabi=lp64d -nostdlib -static -Wall
LDFLAGS := -T $(LDSCRIPT) -nostdlib -static

# All fixtures share andesim.ld (load base 0x00100000, andes_ae350 DRAM).
RT_FIXTURES := rt_all_gprs rt_all_fprs rt_abi_aliases rt_sign_bits rt_pc_jump \
               rt_long_roi rt_mem_loadstore rt_unaligned_lh \
               rt_shared_mem rt_csr_survival rt_m_ext_counters \
               rt_m_ext_trigcause rt_priv_smode rt_priv_umode

# Attack / breakage programs: each demonstrates a bug in the hybrid handoff.
# NOT part of the standard 'all' target (they are expected to misbehave).
# Build individually: make break_vscratch.elf   (etc.)

                  break_verify_diverge

# through the shipped vplat runtime (libandesim_runtime.a) with the
# same two-flag command users type (-B build/runtime
# -specs=andesim.specs), so the suites regression-test the real
# artifact. stdio goes out the ATCUART100 UART2 and exit/file-io through
# the SimControl device at 0xe0080000, all of which both QEMU's
# andes_ae350 and vsim model. No semihosting and no libgloss anywhere:
# vplat_syscalls.o in the archive provides every stub newlib needs, so
# the same ELF runs on fast, cycle AND hybrid and a syscall inside the
# ROI works (it just adds its real cycles to the figure).

                    rt_c_fcsr
RT_C_V_FIXTURES  := rt_c_v_regs rt_c_v_csrs rt_c_v_matmul rt_c_v_fill

RUNTIME_SRCS    := $(RUNTIME_DIR)/crt0.S $(RUNTIME_DIR)/trap.S \
                   $(RUNTIME_DIR)/handler.c

RUNTIME_DEPS    := $(RUNTIME_SRCS) $(RUNTIME_DIR)/vplat_syscalls.c \
                   $(RUNTIME_DIR)/andesim.ld $(RUNTIME_DIR)/andesim.specs \
                   $(RUNTIME_DIR)/ROI.h

VPLAT_RT     := $(VPLAT_RT_DIR)/libandesim_runtime.a $(VPLAT_RT_DIR)/crt0.o \
                $(VPLAT_RT_DIR)/andesim.ld $(VPLAT_RT_DIR)/andesim.specs \
                $(VPLAT_RT_DIR)/include/andesim/ROI.h

# link cleanly into rv64gcv programs (ld unions the arch attributes).
# The crt0 already sets mstatus.VS to Initial, so V insns don't trap.
VPLAT_V_CFLAGS := -march=rv64gcv -mabi=lp64d -O1 -Wall

# A small rv32 set for the arch-match path; the bulk of the fixtures stay rv64.
# Built via `make rv32` (NOT part of `all`), only when HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN32 is set.
# rv32_c_hello reuses rt_c_hello.c (markers are arch-neutral HINTs); rv32_spin
# reuses spin.S. The rv32 runtime comes from build/runtime/rv32 (ARCH=rv32).

CC32           := $(TOOLCHAIN32)/bin/riscv32-unknown-elf-gcc
LD32           := $(TOOLCHAIN32)/bin/riscv32-unknown-elf-ld
CFLAGS32       := -march=rv32gc -mabi=ilp32d -nostdlib -static -Wall
VPLAT_CFLAGS32 := -march=rv32gc -mabi=ilp32d -O1 -Wall
VPLAT_RT32_DIR := ../../build/runtime/rv32
VPLAT_RT32     := $(VPLAT_RT32_DIR)/libandesim_runtime.a $(VPLAT_RT32_DIR)/crt0.o \
                  $(VPLAT_RT32_DIR)/andesim.ld $(VPLAT_RT32_DIR)/andesim.specs \
                  $(VPLAT_RT32_DIR)/include/andesim/ROI.h

.PHONY: all clean dump rv32

all: spin.elf icount_spin.elf handoff.elf handoff_exit.elf handoff_roundtrip.elf \
     l2c_drain.elf \
     $(RT_FIXTURES:%=%.elf) $(RT_C_FIXTURES:%=%.elf) \
     $(RT_C_V_FIXTURES:%=%.elf) rt_c_v_matmul_free.elf \
     $(RT_C_VPLAT_FIXTURES:%=%.elf)

# EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL handoff_smoke.cpp target; they still build here for
# completeness. All targets share andesim.ld at 0x00100000.

	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c spin.S -o spin.o
	$(LD) $(LDFLAGS) spin.o -o $@

# so andes_ae350's MROM at 0x80000000 stays clear when loaded via -bios.
icount_spin.elf: icount_spin.S $(LDSCRIPT)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c icount_spin.S -o icount_spin.o
	$(LD) $(LDFLAGS) icount_spin.o -o $@

handoff.elf: handoff.S $(LDSCRIPT)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c handoff.S -o handoff.o
	$(LD) $(LDFLAGS) handoff.o -o $@

handoff_exit.elf: handoff_exit.S $(LDSCRIPT)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c handoff_exit.S -o handoff_exit.o
	$(LD) $(LDFLAGS) handoff_exit.o -o $@

handoff_roundtrip.elf: handoff_roundtrip.S $(LDSCRIPT) semihost_exit.inc
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c handoff_roundtrip.S -o handoff_roundtrip.o
	$(LD) $(LDFLAGS) handoff_roundtrip.o -o $@

# v5: L2C-drain fixture -- writes the L2C Control Register, then drains (marker).
l2c_drain.elf: l2c_drain.S $(LDSCRIPT) semihost_exit.inc
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c l2c_drain.S -o l2c_drain.o
	$(LD) $(LDFLAGS) l2c_drain.o -o $@

# v6: write-mask fixture -- writes mxstatus/mcache_ctl, reads mmisc_ctl, drains.
wm_drain.elf: wm_drain.S $(LDSCRIPT) semihost_exit.inc
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c wm_drain.S -o wm_drain.o
	$(LD) $(LDFLAGS) wm_drain.o -o $@

$(RT_FIXTURES:%=%.elf): %.elf: %.S $(LDSCRIPT) semihost_exit.inc
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c $< -o $*.o
	$(LD) $(LDFLAGS) $*.o -o $@

# Break fixtures: same link as RT_FIXTURES but no semihost_exit.inc dependency
# (they exit via SimControl or deliberately hang).
$(BREAK_FIXTURES:%=%.elf): %.elf: %.S $(LDSCRIPT)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c $< -o $*.o
	$(LD) $(LDFLAGS) $*.o -o $@

# C-level fixtures: linked exactly like a user program (see VPLAT_RT
# above). rt_c_helpers.h rides -I$(HELPERS_DIR).
$(RT_C_FIXTURES:%=%.elf): %.elf: %.c $(VPLAT_RT) $(HELPERS_DIR)/rt_c_helpers.h
	$(CC) $(VPLAT_CFLAGS) -I$(HELPERS_DIR) \
	  -B $(VPLAT_RT_DIR) -specs=andesim.specs $< -o $@

# RVV-enabled fixtures: same link, different -march. Listed separately so
# changes to VPLAT_CFLAGS don't accidentally drop V.
$(RT_C_V_FIXTURES:%=%.elf): %.elf: %.c $(VPLAT_RT) $(HELPERS_DIR)/rt_c_helpers.h
	$(CC) $(VPLAT_V_CFLAGS) -I$(HELPERS_DIR) \
	  -B $(VPLAT_RT_DIR) -specs=andesim.specs $< -o $@

# vplat smoke fixtures (tests/vplat/): exercise the runtime's own
# features (exit code, file io) with no fixture helpers.
$(RT_C_VPLAT_FIXTURES:%=%.elf): %.elf: %.c $(VPLAT_RT)
	$(CC) $(VPLAT_CFLAGS) -B $(VPLAT_RT_DIR) -specs=andesim.specs $< -o $@

# One sub-make produces all five artifacts (grouped target, make >= 4.3).
$(VPLAT_RT) &: $(RUNTIME_DEPS)
	$(MAKE) -C $(RUNTIME_DIR)

# Markerless GEMM twin (gemm_modes.md F2). Explicit rule, NOT in
# RT_C_V_FIXTURES -- the pattern rule would look for a nonexistent
# rt_c_v_matmul_free.c. Same source, same link as the marked V fixtures,
# plus -DHYBRID_MARKERLESS (drops the ROI marker HINTs).
rt_c_v_matmul_free.elf: rt_c_v_matmul.c $(VPLAT_RT) $(HELPERS_DIR)/rt_c_helpers.h
	$(CC) $(VPLAT_V_CFLAGS) -DHYBRID_MARKERLESS -I$(HELPERS_DIR) \
	  -B $(VPLAT_RT_DIR) -specs=andesim.specs rt_c_v_matmul.c -o $@

# rv32 fixtures: one bare-asm (no runtime) + one C (links the rv32 runtime).
rv32: rv32_spin.elf rv32_c_hello.elf

rv32_spin.elf: spin.S $(LDSCRIPT)
	$(CC32) $(CFLAGS32) -c spin.S -o rv32_spin.o
	$(LD32) -T $(LDSCRIPT) -nostdlib -static rv32_spin.o -o $@

rv32_c_hello.elf: rt_c_hello.c $(VPLAT_RT32) $(HELPERS_DIR)/rt_c_helpers.h
	$(CC32) $(VPLAT_CFLAGS32) -I$(HELPERS_DIR) \
	  -B $(VPLAT_RT32_DIR) -specs=andesim.specs rt_c_hello.c -o $@

# rv32 runtime (grouped target): the runtime Makefile with ARCH=rv32.
$(VPLAT_RT32) &: $(RUNTIME_DEPS)
	$(MAKE) -C $(RUNTIME_DIR) ARCH=rv32 HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN32=$(TOOLCHAIN32)

dump: spin.elf handoff.elf handoff_exit.elf
	$(OBJDUMP) -d spin.elf
	$(OBJDUMP) -d handoff.elf
	$(OBJDUMP) -d handoff_exit.elf

clean:
	rm -f spin.o spin.elf handoff.o handoff.elf handoff_exit.o handoff_exit.elf \
	      handoff_roundtrip.o handoff_roundtrip.elf \
	      $(RT_FIXTURES:%=%.o) $(RT_FIXTURES:%=%.elf) \
	      $(RT_C_FIXTURES:%=%.elf) $(RT_C_V_FIXTURES:%=%.elf) \
	      rt_c_v_matmul_free.elf $(RT_C_VPLAT_FIXTURES:%=%.elf) \
	      $(BREAK_FIXTURES:%=%.o) $(BREAK_FIXTURES:%=%.elf) \
	      rv32_spin.o rv32_spin.elf rv32_c_hello.elf

#   andesim.ld             linker script (load base 0x00100000)
#   include/andesim/ROI.h  ROI markers (HINT NOPs; same dir rides -B)
#
# Users link with:
#   gcc ... -B <repo>/build/runtime -specs=andesim.specs hello.c
# or, without the gcc driver:
#   gcc ... -nostartfiles -nodefaultlibs -T andesim.ld crt0.o hello.c \
#       -L <repo>/build/runtime \
#       -Wl,--start-group -landesim_runtime -lc -lgcc -Wl,--end-group
#
# Toolchain location comes from config.env (HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN), same as
# tests/fixtures/Makefile.

# ARCH selects the target width: rv64 (default) or rv32. Each arch has its own
# toolchain (HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN / HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN32), triple, -march/-mabi, and
# output dir. rv64 stays at build/runtime (back-compat with `-B build/runtime`);
# rv32 lands at build/runtime/rv32 (`-B build/runtime/rv32`).
ARCH ?= rv64

ifeq ($(ARCH),rv64)
  TOOLCHAIN ?= $(HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN)
  TRIPLE    := riscv64-unknown-elf
  ARCHFLAGS := -march=rv64gc -mabi=lp64d
  OUT       ?= ../build/runtime
else ifeq ($(ARCH),rv32)
  TOOLCHAIN ?= $(HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN32)
  TRIPLE    := riscv32-unknown-elf
  ARCHFLAGS := -march=rv32gc -mabi=ilp32d
  OUT       ?= ../build/runtime/rv32
else
  $(error ARCH must be rv64 or rv32, got '$(ARCH)')
endif

ifeq ($(strip $(TOOLCHAIN)),)
$(error No toolchain for ARCH=$(ARCH). Set HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN (rv64) / HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN32 (rv32) in config.env, `source ./setup.sh`, or pass TOOLCHAIN=/path)
endif

CC := $(TOOLCHAIN)/bin/$(TRIPLE)-gcc
AR := $(TOOLCHAIN)/bin/$(TRIPLE)-ar

# rvNNgc objects link cleanly into rvNNgcv programs (ld unions the RISC-V arch
# attributes), so one build serves both -march variants of the arch.
CFLAGS := $(ARCHFLAGS) -O1 -Wall

LIB_OBJS := $(OUT)/trap.o $(OUT)/handler.o $(OUT)/vplat_syscalls.o

.PHONY: all clean

all: $(OUT)/libandesim_runtime.a $(OUT)/crt0.o $(OUT)/andesim.ld \
     $(OUT)/andesim.specs $(OUT)/include/andesim/ROI.h

$(OUT):
	mkdir -p $@

$(OUT)/%.o: %.S | $(OUT)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c $< -o $@

$(OUT)/%.o: %.c | $(OUT)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c $< -o $@

$(OUT)/trap.o: core_v5.h

$(OUT)/libandesim_runtime.a: $(LIB_OBJS)
	$(AR) rcs $@ $^

$(OUT)/andesim.ld: andesim.ld | $(OUT)
	cp $< $@

$(OUT)/andesim.specs: andesim.specs | $(OUT)
	cp $< $@

# command resolves #include <andesim/ROI.h> with no extra -I.

	mkdir -p $(dir $@)
	cp $< $@

	rm -rf $(OUT)

=== rt_c_helpers.h (final) ===
/* Drain markers shared by all C-level round-trip fixtures.
 *
 * Syscalls: all C-level fixtures link the vplat runtime
 * (build/runtime/libandesim_runtime.a, no semihosting): newlib stdio
 * bottoms out in the ATCUART100 UART2 and exit/file-io in the SimControl
 * device, which BOTH engines model. A syscall inside the
 * enter_vsim()/exit_vsim() span therefore works on vsim too -- it just
 * adds its real cycles (UART polling, dcache flush) to the measured
 * figure, so cycle-measuring fixtures keep the span syscall-free by
 * choice, not by rule.
 */

#ifndef RT_C_HELPERS_H
#define RT_C_HELPERS_H

/* Plugin- / handoff-controller-recognized drain markers: the HINT pair
 * `slti x0, x0, 0x5A0` (ENTER) / `slti x0, x0, 0x5A1` (EXIT). Match
 * insn_match.h. rd=x0 makes each marker an architectural NOP, so marked
 * binaries also run standalone on every engine.
 *
 * marker mode pattern-matches the HINT insns directly; the helpers do not
 * export any `_hybrid_*_pc` symbol. PC-trigger callers pass the switch PCs
 * explicitly via `--pc-start`/`--pc-end` (or the env-var pair
 * `ROI_START`/`ROI_END`); see tests/lib/roi.sh. */
/* The "memory" clobber forces the compiler to spill all globals to memory
 * across the marker and reload them after, since vsim's drain+resume is
 * (from the compiler's POV) an opaque event that could observe or alter
 * any memory. Without it, the compiler may hoist global-pointer arithmetic
 * (e.g. &_impure_ptr) into a callee-saved register across the marker and
 * use it after resume; if vsim doesn't faithfully restore that register
 * the post-resume code dereferences garbage. The clobber list deliberately
 * does NOT include GPRs: the round-trip is required to preserve them. */
/* Cycle-attribution contract (for cycle-measuring benchmarks):
 *
 * The "memory" clobber pins memory loads/stores across the marker but NOT
 * register-only computation. A vector kernel that keeps its inputs/outputs
 * in vector registers across the boundary can be hoisted before enter_vsim
 * or sunk after exit_vsim, charging its cycles to the wrong phase. (Tested
 * on the Andes GCC at -O2/-O3: an out-of-line marker does NOT help -- a
 * call only forces a register spill, not the position of the compute that
 * consumes the value.)
 *
 * To keep a kernel inside the measured window, anchor it through memory:
 *   - read its inputs from memory and write its outputs to memory INSIDE
 *     the span (the load cannot move before enter, the store cannot move
 *     after exit, and the compute is data-chained between them), or
 *   - put the kernel in its own __attribute__((noinline)) function called
 *     between the markers.
 * Both keep every kernel op in the ROI with zero annotation and zero
 * overhead. Carrying live vector values in registers across the boundary is
 * fine for CORRECTNESS (all regs round-trip) -- rt_c_v_regs.c does exactly
 * that (relying on the compiler keeping x in a V register across the
 * boundary) as the V-regfile TRANSPORT test -- but it is not safe for cycle
 * attribution. */
static inline void enter_vsim(void)
{
  __asm__ __volatile__("slti x0, x0, 0x5A0\n" ::: "memory");
}
static inline void exit_vsim(void)
{
  __asm__ __volatile__("slti x0, x0, 0x5A1\n" ::: "memory");
}

/* A pure compiler memory barrier (emits no instructions): forces pending
 * memory writes to complete and bars reordering across it. enter_vsim /
 * exit_vsim already carry this clobber on their marker insn, so the markers
 * anchor a kernel's output stores; markerless builds (-DHYBRID_MARKERLESS)
 * call roi_anchor() to pin those stores instead. */
static inline void roi_anchor(void)
{
  __asm__ __volatile__("" ::: "memory");
}

#endif /* RT_C_HELPERS_H */

===== FINAL scripts/build_runtime.sh =====
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Build the user-facing andesim runtime (runtime/) for both arches. Produces:
#   build/runtime/       libandesim_runtime.a, crt0.o, andesim.ld, andesim.specs,
#                        include/andesim/ROI.h   (rv64; link -B build/runtime)
#   build/runtime/rv32/  the same, rv32          (rv32; link -B build/runtime/rv32)
# Users link with `-B <dir> -specs=andesim.specs` (USER_GUIDE.md section 5).
#
# rv64 always builds (HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN). rv32 builds too when HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN32
# is set. Self-contained: fills either toolchain from config.env (exported env
# wins), like setup.sh, so it runs without `source ./setup.sh` first.
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
SRC="$ROOT/runtime"
CONFIG_FILE="$ROOT/config.env"
CONFIG_TEMPLATE="$ROOT/config.env.example"

[[ -f "$SRC/Makefile" ]] || { echo "missing $SRC/Makefile" >&2; exit 1; }

# Capture exported values (they win), then source config.env to fill any gaps.
ENV_TC64="${HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN:-}"
ENV_TC32="${HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN32:-}"
if [[ -z "$ENV_TC64" || -z "$ENV_TC32" ]]; then
  if [[ ! -f "$CONFIG_FILE" ]]; then
    [[ -f "$CONFIG_TEMPLATE" ]] \
      || { echo "missing $CONFIG_TEMPLATE; cannot create $CONFIG_FILE" >&2; exit 1; }
    cp "$CONFIG_TEMPLATE" "$CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "created $CONFIG_FILE from template -- edit it if your toolchains live elsewhere" >&2
  fi
  # shellcheck source=/dev/null
  . "$CONFIG_FILE"
fi
[[ -n "$ENV_TC64" ]] && HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN="$ENV_TC64"
[[ -n "$ENV_TC32" ]] && HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN32="$ENV_TC32"

# rv64 (required).
if [[ -z "${HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN:-}" || ! -d "${HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN:-}/bin" ]]; then
  echo "HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN unset or has no bin/; check $CONFIG_FILE" >&2
  exit 1
fi
make -C "$SRC" ARCH=rv64 TOOLCHAIN="$HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN"
echo "built: $ROOT/build/runtime/libandesim_runtime.a (rv64)"

# rv32 (optional: needs the second toolchain).
if [[ -n "${HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN32:-}" && -d "${HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN32:-}/bin" ]]; then
  make -C "$SRC" ARCH=rv32 TOOLCHAIN="$HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN32"
  echo "built: $ROOT/build/runtime/rv32/libandesim_runtime.a (rv32)"
else
  echo "skipped rv32 runtime: set HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN32 in $CONFIG_FILE to build it" >&2
fi

################ tests/vplat/test_vplat_f7.sh ################
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Runtime-lib F2 contract: `make -C runtime` produces a linkable library
# under build/runtime/ so users stop listing the 4 runtime sources:
#
#   build/runtime/libandesim_runtime.a   (trap.o handler.o vplat_syscalls.o)
#   build/runtime/crt0.o                   (startfile; OUTSIDE the archive)
#   build/runtime/andesim.ld             (linker script)
#
# Probe: link vplat_hello.c with the raw library line (no specs file yet)
# and run it on the cycle engine -- prints via UART, exits 0 via SimControl.
set -uo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"

# shellcheck disable=SC1091
. "$ROOT/config.env" 2>/dev/null
export HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN="${HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN:?config.env missing}"
GCC="$HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN/bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-gcc"
NM="$HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN/bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-nm"

SIM="${VSIM_BIN_DIR:-$ROOT/verilator/build}/sim_ax45mpv_premium"
[ -x "$SIM" ] || fail "cycle engine not built: $SIM"

make -C "$ROOT/runtime" || fail "runtime lib build failed"

RT="$ROOT/build/runtime"
[ -f "$RT/libandesim_runtime.a" ] || fail "missing $RT/libandesim_runtime.a"
[ -f "$RT/crt0.o" ] || fail "missing $RT/crt0.o"
[ -f "$RT/andesim.ld" ] || fail "missing $RT/andesim.ld"

# crt0 must be a standalone startfile: the archive never gets _start pulled.
# (grep without -q: early-exit + pipefail turns a MATCH into SIGPIPE failure)
"$NM" "$RT/crt0.o" | grep ' T _start' >/dev/null \
  || fail "crt0.o does not define _start"
"$NM" "$RT/libandesim_runtime.a" | grep ' T _write' >/dev/null \
  || fail "archive does not define _write"
"$NM" "$RT/libandesim_runtime.a" | grep ' T m_trap_entry' >/dev/null \
  || fail "archive does not define m_trap_entry"

# Raw (non-specs) link: what a non-gcc-driver build system would write.
TMP=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
"$GCC" -march=rv64gc -mabi=lp64d -O1 -static -nostartfiles -nodefaultlibs \
  -T "$RT/andesim.ld" "$RT/crt0.o" "$ROOT/tests/fixtures/vplat_hello.c" \
  -L "$RT" -Wl,--start-group -landesim_runtime -lc -lgcc -Wl,--end-group \
  -o "$TMP/hello.elf" || fail "raw -landesim_runtime link failed"

OUT=$(timeout 120 "$SIM" "$TMP/hello.elf" </dev/null 2>&1); RC=$?
printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -q 'hello from vplat' \
  || fail "cycle: missing 'hello from vplat' in: $OUT"
[ "$RC" -eq 0 ] || fail "cycle: exit code $RC != 0 (output: $OUT)"

ok "F2 libandesim_runtime.a links and runs on the cycle engine"

################ tests/vplat/test_vplat_f8.sh ################
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Runtime-lib F3 contract: the whole link recipe collapses into two flags --
#
#   gcc -march=rv64gc -mabi=lp64d -O1 \
#       -B <repo>/build/runtime -specs=andesim.specs hello.c -o hello.elf
#
# The specs file swaps the startfile to our crt0.o, appends -T andesim.ld
# and rewrites the library sequence to
# `--start-group -landesim_runtime -lc -lgcc --end-group` (no -lgloss,
# no semihosting). The produced ELF must run on all three engines.
set -uo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"

# shellcheck disable=SC1091
. "$ROOT/config.env" 2>/dev/null
export HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN="${HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN:?config.env missing}"
GCC="$HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN/bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-gcc"

BIN="$ROOT/build/andesim"
SIM="${VSIM_BIN_DIR:-$ROOT/verilator/build}/sim_ax45mpv_premium"
RT="$ROOT/build/runtime"
[ -x "$BIN" ] || fail "driver not built: $BIN"
[ -x "$SIM" ] || fail "cycle engine not built: $SIM"
[ -x "$ROOT/build/qemu/qemu-system-riscv64" ] || fail "qemu not built"
[ -f "$ROOT/qemu_plugin/libhybrid_handoff.so" ] || fail "plugin not built"

make -C "$ROOT/runtime" >/dev/null || fail "runtime lib build failed"

TMP=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
cat > "$TMP/hello.c" <<'EOF'
#include <stdio.h>

__attribute__((noinline)) void say_hello(void)
{
  printf("hello from specs\n");
}

int main(void)
{
  say_hello();
  __asm__ __volatile__(".globl vplat_roi_end\nvplat_roi_end:" ::: "memory");
  return 0;
}
EOF

# The two-flag user command (plus a link map for the no-gloss assert).
"$GCC" -march=rv64gc -mabi=lp64d -O1 \
  -B "$RT" -specs=andesim.specs "$TMP/hello.c" -o "$TMP/hello.elf" \
  -Wl,-Map,"$TMP/hello.map" || fail "two-flag specs link failed"

grep 'libandesim_runtime\.a' "$TMP/hello.map" >/dev/null \
  || fail "link map does not pull libandesim_runtime.a"
if grep 'gloss' "$TMP/hello.map" >/dev/null; then
  fail "link map pulls a libgloss (semihosting leaked into the link)"
fi

# cycle
OUT=$(timeout 120 "$SIM" "$TMP/hello.elf" </dev/null 2>&1); RC=$?
printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -q 'hello from specs' \
  || fail "cycle: missing 'hello from specs' in: $OUT"
[ "$RC" -eq 0 ] || fail "cycle: exit code $RC != 0 (output: $OUT)"

# fast
OUT=$(timeout 60 "$BIN" run --mode fast "$TMP/hello.elf" </dev/null 2>&1); RC=$?
printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -q 'hello from specs' \
  || fail "fast: missing 'hello from specs' in: $OUT"
[ "$RC" -eq 0 ] || fail "fast: exit code $RC != 0 (output: $OUT)"

# hybrid (pc trigger on the same symbols a user would publish)
OUT=$(timeout 180 "$BIN" run --mode hybrid --trigger pc \
        --engine vsim:ax45mpv_premium \
        --pc-start say_hello --pc-end vplat_roi_end \
        "$TMP/hello.elf" </dev/null 2>&1)
RC=$?
printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -q 'hello from specs' \
  || fail "hybrid: missing 'hello from specs' in: $OUT"
printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -Eq '^\[pc window_cycles\] [0-9]+' \
  || fail "hybrid: missing window_cycles line: $OUT"
[ "$RC" -eq 0 ] || fail "hybrid: exit code $RC != 0 (output: $OUT)"

ok "F3 -specs=andesim.specs builds one ELF that runs on fast, cycle, hybrid"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ROI-marker portability contract (docs/archive/roi_markers.md F3): the markers shipped
# in <andesim/ROI.h> are RISC-V HINTs (slti x0, x0, 0x5A0/0x5A1), i.e.
# architectural NOPs. ONE marker binary must therefore
#
#   1. run to completion standalone on --mode fast  (the old csrwi 0x7C0
#      markers died here: 0x7C0 is MILMB on Andes cores, the exit marker
#      enabled ILM at base 0 and trapped forever),
#   2. run to completion standalone on the cycle engine,
#   3. hand off on --mode hybrid --trigger marker and print window_cycles.
#
# The same two-flag user command as F8; the header rides the -B prefix
# (gcc adds <prefix>/include to the include path).
set -uo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"

# shellcheck disable=SC1091
. "$ROOT/config.env" 2>/dev/null
export HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN="${HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN:?config.env missing}"
GCC="$HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN/bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-gcc"

BIN="$ROOT/build/andesim"
SIM="${VSIM_BIN_DIR:-$ROOT/verilator/build}/sim_ax45mpv_premium"
RT="$ROOT/build/runtime"
[ -x "$BIN" ] || fail "driver not built: $BIN"
[ -x "$SIM" ] || fail "cycle engine not built: $SIM"
[ -x "$ROOT/build/qemu/qemu-system-riscv64" ] || fail "qemu not built"
[ -f "$ROOT/qemu_plugin/libhybrid_handoff.so" ] || fail "plugin not built"

make -C "$ROOT/runtime" >/dev/null || fail "runtime lib build failed"
[ -f "$RT/include/andesim/ROI.h" ] || fail "runtime did not install andesim/ROI.h"

TMP=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
cat > "$TMP/roi.c" <<'EOF'
#include <andesim/ROI.h>
#include <stdio.h>

static volatile unsigned src[64], dst[64];

int main(void)
{
  printf("before roi\n");
  andesim_ROI_begin();
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 64; i++)  /* memory-anchored kernel */
    dst[i] = src[i] + i;
  andesim_ROI_end();
  printf("after roi\n");
  return 0;
}
EOF

"$GCC" -march=rv64gc -mabi=lp64d -O1 \
  -B "$RT" -specs=andesim.specs "$TMP/roi.c" -o "$TMP/roi.elf" \
  || fail "two-flag build with <andesim/ROI.h> failed"

# The binary must embed exactly the published wire encodings.
OBJDUMP="$HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN/bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-objdump"
DIS=$("$OBJDUMP" -d "$TMP/roi.elf")
printf '%s\n' "$DIS" | awk '$2 == "5a002013"' | grep -q . \
  || fail "enter marker 0x5A002013 not found in disassembly"
printf '%s\n' "$DIS" | awk '$2 == "5a102013"' | grep -q . \
  || fail "exit marker 0x5A102013 not found in disassembly"

# 1. fast, standalone: markers are NOPs, program must finish.
OUT=$(timeout 60 "$BIN" run --mode fast "$TMP/roi.elf" </dev/null 2>&1); RC=$?
printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -q 'before roi' || fail "fast: missing 'before roi': $OUT"
printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -q 'after roi'  || fail "fast: missing 'after roi': $OUT"
[ "$RC" -eq 0 ] || fail "fast: exit code $RC != 0 (output: $OUT)"

# 2. cycle, standalone: same.
OUT=$(timeout 120 "$SIM" "$TMP/roi.elf" </dev/null 2>&1); RC=$?
printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -q 'before roi' || fail "cycle: missing 'before roi': $OUT"
printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -q 'after roi'  || fail "cycle: missing 'after roi': $OUT"
[ "$RC" -eq 0 ] || fail "cycle: exit code $RC != 0 (output: $OUT)"

# 3. hybrid, marker trigger: the same markers drive the handoff.
OUT=$(timeout 180 "$BIN" run --mode hybrid --trigger marker \
        --engine vsim:ax45mpv_premium "$TMP/roi.elf" </dev/null 2>&1)
RC=$?
printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -Eq '^\[marker window_cycles\] [0-9]+' \
  || fail "hybrid: missing window_cycles line: $OUT"
[ "$RC" -eq 0 ] || fail "hybrid: exit code $RC != 0 (output: $OUT)"

===== runtime/ROI.h =====
/* andesim/ROI.h - ROI markers for cycle measurement.
 *
 * andesim_ROI_begin()/andesim_ROI_end() delimit the region of
 * interest. On `--mode hybrid --trigger marker` the simulator switches
 * QEMU -> vsim at begin and drains at end; the reported window_cycles
 * covers exactly the span between the two markers.
 *
 * The markers are RISC-V HINT instructions (slti x0, x0, 0x5A0/0x5A1).
 * An rd=x0 instruction discards its result, so each marker is an
 * architectural NOP on every conforming core: the SAME binary runs
 * unmodified on --mode fast, --mode cycle, and real silicon.
 *
 * Cycle-attribution contract: the "memory" clobber pins memory accesses
 * across the marker but NOT register-only computation -- the compiler may
 * hoist a register-resident kernel out of the span. To keep a kernel
 * inside the measured window, anchor it through memory (read inputs /
 * write outputs inside the span) or call it as a noinline function
 * between the markers.
 */

#ifndef ANDESIM_ROI_H
#define ANDESIM_ROI_H

static inline void andesim_ROI_begin(void)
{
  __asm__ __volatile__("slti x0, x0, 0x5A0\n" ::: "memory");
}

static inline void andesim_ROI_end(void)
{
  __asm__ __volatile__("slti x0, x0, 0x5A1\n" ::: "memory");
}

#endif /* ANDESIM_ROI_H */

# Build the user-facing andesim runtime (runtime/). Produces:
#   build/runtime/   libandesim_runtime.a, crt0.o, andesim.ld, andesim.specs,
#                    include/andesim/ROI.h

fi
[[ -n "$ENV_TC64" ]] && HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN="$ENV_TC64"

  echo "HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN unset or has no bin/; check $CONFIG_FILE" >&2
  exit 1
fi

make -C "$SRC" TOOLCHAIN="$HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# build_all.sh -- build the andesim artifacts. This is the entry point that
# replaced the former `andesim build` subcommand (which moved out of the driver
# binary). It only orchestrates the existing build scripts / Makefiles; the
# build logic itself lives in setup.sh, scripts/build_*.sh, and the Makefiles.
#
# Usage:
#   scripts/build_all.sh [TARGET] [--dry-run]
#
# TARGET (default: all):
#   all       setup.sh (locate external qemu + vsim + plugin) then
#             fixtures (the fixtures Makefile also builds the runtime lib too)
#   plugin    qemu_plugin/libhybrid_handoff.so
#   fixtures  tests/fixtures/*.elf (+ runtime lib)
#   runtime   build/runtime/ (rv64) + build/runtime/rv32/ (rv32, when
#             HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN32 is set): libandesim_runtime.a, crt0.o,
#             andesim.ld, andesim.specs, include/andesim/ROI.h
#
# --dry-run prints the underlying commands without running them.
#
# The andesim driver itself is NOT built here: ./andesim self-bootstraps via
# scripts/build_driver.sh on first use.
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"

TARGET=all
DRY_RUN=0
for arg in "$@"; do
  case "$arg" in
    --dry-run) DRY_RUN=1 ;;
    all|plugin|fixtures|runtime) TARGET="$arg" ;;
    *)
      echo "build_all.sh: unknown argument: $arg" >&2
      echo "usage: build_all.sh [all|plugin|fixtures|runtime] [--dry-run]" >&2
      exit 2
      ;;
  esac
done

# run one step: print it under --dry-run, otherwise banner + execute (inheriting
# stdio so the user watches the build live). set -e aborts on the first failure.
run() {
  if [ "$DRY_RUN" = "1" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$*"
    return
  fi
  printf '[build_all] %s\n' "$*"
  "$@"
}

# plugin: build_qemu_plugin.sh wraps `make -C qemu_plugin`; plugins build against
# the vendored qemu_plugin/include/qemu-plugin.h (no QEMU source tree needed).
case "$TARGET" in
  all)      run bash "$ROOT/setup.sh"; run make -C "$ROOT/tests/fixtures" ;;
  plugin)   run bash "$ROOT/scripts/build_qemu_plugin.sh" ;;
  fixtures) run make -C "$ROOT/tests/fixtures" ;;
  runtime)  run bash "$ROOT/scripts/build_runtime.sh" ;;
esac

# Build tiny RV64 fixtures used by hybrid smoke tests.
#
# Toolchain location comes from the repo-root config.env (loaded by
# `source ./setup.sh`, which exports HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN). Override on the
# command line with `make TOOLCHAIN=/path/to/toolchain ...` if you want
# to bypass the env var.

TOOLCHAIN ?= $(HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN)
ifeq ($(strip $(TOOLCHAIN)),)
$(error HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN is not set. Run `source ./setup.sh` from the repo root, or pass `TOOLCHAIN=/path/to/toolchain` on the command line)
endif
CC        := $(TOOLCHAIN)/bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-gcc
LD        := $(TOOLCHAIN)/bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-ld
OBJDUMP   := $(TOOLCHAIN)/bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-objdump

# Runtime sources live at the repo root (runtime/) -- they are the
# user-facing andesim runtime; fixtures are just one consumer. The linker
# script moved with them (test.ld -> runtime/andesim.ld, same content).
RUNTIME_DIR := ../../runtime
LDSCRIPT    := $(RUNTIME_DIR)/andesim.ld
# Fixture-only helpers (csr ROI markers; NOT part of the portable runtime).
HELPERS_DIR := runtime

CFLAGS  := -march=rv64gc -mabi=lp64d -nostdlib -static -Wall
LDFLAGS := -T $(LDSCRIPT) -nostdlib -static

# All fixtures share andesim.ld (load base 0x00100000, andes_ae350 DRAM).
RT_FIXTURES := rt_all_gprs rt_abi_aliases rt_sign_bits rt_pc_jump \
               rt_long_roi rt_mem_loadstore rt_unaligned_lh \
               rt_shared_mem rt_csr_survival

# C-level fixtures: standard newlib stdio (printf, fputs, ...) linked
# against the Andes virtual-hosting libgloss (libgloss_vh.a), which
# implements _write / _exit / _sbrk / _read / ... via the RISC-V
# semihosting magic triple. QEMU1 is launched with
# -semihosting-config enable=on,target=native and intercepts the triple
# before it reaches mtvec. vsim does not implement semihosting -- phase
# 2 (the span between enter_vsim and exit_vsim)
# is therefore syscall-free by rule (see runtime/rt_c_helpers.h).
RT_C_FIXTURES    := rt_c_hello rt_c_printf rt_c_matmul rt_c_static_buf
RT_C_V_FIXTURES  := rt_c_v_regs rt_c_v_csrs rt_c_v_matmul
RT_C_VPLAT_FIXTURES := vplat_hello vplat_exit41 vplat_file

RUNTIME_SRCS    := $(RUNTIME_DIR)/crt0.S $(RUNTIME_DIR)/trap.S \
                   $(RUNTIME_DIR)/handler.c
# V fixtures use the standard C runtime (RUNTIME_SRCS). V regfile transport
# is handled transparently inside vsim via the Debug Module Program Buffer
# (ResumeDriver/StateDrain), so no per-fixture transport TU is linked.
# -nodefaultlibs suppresses the toolchain's default -lc/-lgloss/-lgcc;
# we re-add them inside --start-group so -lgloss_vh's semihosting stubs
# resolve newlib's _write / _exit / _sbrk / ... before -lgloss (the
# proxy-kernel ecall variant) is even searched. Order matters:
# -lgloss_vh must precede the fallback -lgloss path.
RT_C_LIBS       := -Wl,--start-group -lc -lgloss_vh -lgcc -Wl,--end-group
# vplat: built THROUGH the shipped runtime library with the same two-flag
# command users type (-B build/runtime -specs=andesim.specs), so the suites
# regression-test the real artifact. No libgloss anywhere: vplat_syscalls.o
# in the archive provides every stub newlib needs.
VPLAT_RT_DIR := ../../build/runtime
VPLAT_RT     := $(VPLAT_RT_DIR)/libandesim_runtime.a $(VPLAT_RT_DIR)/crt0.o \
                $(VPLAT_RT_DIR)/andesim.ld $(VPLAT_RT_DIR)/andesim.specs \
                $(VPLAT_RT_DIR)/include/andesim/ROI.h
VPLAT_CFLAGS := -march=rv64gc -mabi=lp64d -O1 -Wall
RT_C_CFLAGS     := -march=rv64gc -mabi=lp64d -O1 -static -nostartfiles \
                   -nodefaultlibs -I$(HELPERS_DIR) -Wall
# RVV-using fixtures need -march=rv64gcv. The crt0 already sets
# mstatus.VS to Initial, so V instructions don't trap.
RT_C_V_CFLAGS   := -march=rv64gcv -mabi=lp64d -O1 -static -nostartfiles \
                   -nodefaultlibs -I$(HELPERS_DIR) -Wall

.PHONY: all clean dump

all: spin.elf handoff_exit.elf handoff_roundtrip.elf \
     $(RT_FIXTURES:%=%.elf) $(RT_C_FIXTURES:%=%.elf) \
     $(RT_C_V_FIXTURES:%=%.elf) $(RT_C_VPLAT_FIXTURES:%=%.elf)

	$(LD) $(LDFLAGS) $*.o -o $@

# preserves input order within the .text wildcard.

	$(OBJDUMP) -d handoff_exit.elf
